verdict.rationale: Workable documents recruitment pipeline stages defined on a recruiting preferences page, exposed through the /stages endpoint, and its official MCP server can move candidates through the pipeline. That is a thin but direct sign of configurable pipelines with candidate movement. missing for 10: evidence of custom stages per job (not just account-wide), a drag-to-move UI, bulk actions across the pipeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Calling the /stages endpoint will return a collection of the recruitment pipeline stages as defined in recruiting preferences page
copy or relocate them across jobs, move them through the pipeline, rate and review them
